hero.title: African Art, Culture and Cosmetics
descriptions: Art and culture are essential to understanding the world and our place in it.
They connect us to our roots, identity, and history.
African cosmetics, rooted in ancestral traditions, celebrate the natural beauty and diversity of the continent.
Together, they form a bridge between the past and the future, enriching the human experience.

teferet.title: TEFERET LTD
teferet.description: Promotion of medicinal and edible plants, spices, and barks in ethnic cosmetics. Enhancement of African endogenous and ancestral heritage.

acarad.title: ACARAD
acarad.description: Association for the promotion of African knowledge, cultures, and the reconnection of Afro-descendants.
